messages:
elaine: sharing a new mock for the Usage & Billing canvas. big question: show token + fiat inline for every row or show tokens only + a per-row cost chip? figma: https://figma.com/s/usage-billing-v5

harry: inline fiat is useful for finance folks but clutters scanning. suggestion: compact chip `4.2k tokens · $0.23` as persistent inline element.

maya: +1 for persistent chip. hover-only is a11y fail for keyboard/mobile. also: org vs project default view? i'm leaning org => grouped rollups, project => full ledger.

sam: agreement on defaults. small UX ask: put the view toggle near the scope pill so it's obvious they're related. label it `View: Grouped | List`.

anya: accessibility nit: toggle should be a segmented control with `role="tablist"` or a proper `aria-pressed` pair. ensure focus styles and screen reader text: "Switch view mode: grouped or list".

harry: analytics idea: show `median tokens` and `p95 tokens` in grouped rows so ops can spot outliers without expanding.

maya: good call. also invoice provenance: legal wants a direct link from a line item to the invoice PDF. current mock shows invoice id inline which reads noisy. proposal: keep invoice id only in expanded ledger + add `View invoice` action in grouped row modal.

elaine: mock change: grouped row will have 3 primary actions: `Drill` (keyboard-friendly), `Statement (PDF)`, `Export (CSV)`. thoughts?

sam: prefer `Statement (PDF)` label over `Invoice` to avoid policy confusion. add microcopy under CTA: "Issued monthly; click to download full statement."

billing-bot: Note: last invoice generation run succeeded for acct:redwood-prod at 2026-09-09T02:44:10Z

anya: copy suggestion: instead of "Token breakdown" use "Usage details" across all headings for consistency with onboarding docs.

harry: performance: grouped view needs pre-aggregated API. backend flag idea: `aggregate=project,day`. we'll need pagination on expand because ledger could be huge.

maya: UI detail: show sparkline in grouped row to communicate trend. accessibility: if sparkline conveys data, include offscreen text like "Tokens trending up 12% vs prior period".

elaine: visual density question: do we show a small avatar/team badge in grouped rows? helps when multiple owners.

sam: team badge ok but hide on mobile, keep compact. also, mobile should default to grouped and a top-level filter to pick a project.

anya: keyboard flow: expand should be a single keypress (Enter) when focused on the row; ensure `aria-expanded` toggles and focus moves into first ledger cell.

maya: plan: i'll push two variants — (A) grouped-first with chips + sparklines, (B) list-first with inline fiat column. will annotate a11y changes and copy alternatives.

harry: once mocks are up i'll review the API contract with infra for `aggregate` param and expected payload (median/p95 + sparkline points).

elaine: timeline: can we get a prototype by Fri? this needs legal review for statement wording before next release.

sam: i'll handle the legal sync. anya, can you run a quick keyboard/a11y pass after maya posts?

anya: yes, I'll test focus order, screen reader labels, and color contrast.

maya: thanks all — posting updated mocks by EOD today. :sparkles:
